backlog.notes: Repo audit complete. Backend has Phases 1-4 partially implemented on SQLite: schedule/progress ingestion, Time-Agent chat, hybrid matching engine, confidence scoring, planner review queue, audit trail, XER import/export with predecessor/successor. Missing: PostgreSQL, Redis/Celery, JWT/RBAC, Alembic, frontend, design system, synthetic data generator, SQLite backup mechanism. Python 3.9 incompatible union syntax in matching/service.py and extraction_service.py. No docker-compose.yml. P5 XER round-trip partially implemented but needs verification against full spec (.mpp support, write-back on approval, export).

PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector configured via docker-compose.yml. Alembic initial migration (d688256165ff) created with all PRD §9 tables: organizations, users, projects, ingestion_sources, wbs_nodes (with vector(1536)), event_wbs_matches, glossary_mappings, delay_reasons, productivity_benchmarks, audit_logs, plus existing Phase 1-4 tables. Migration runs clean on fresh SQLite and PostgreSQL. Database.py supports both SQLite (dev) and PostgreSQL (prod) with async/sync engines.

Redis and Celery configured in docker-compose.yml. Celery app in app/core/celery_app.py with worker, beat, and backup task (app/workers/backup.py). Redis used as broker and result backend. Beat schedule includes hourly SQLite backup task.

JWT auth with access/refresh tokens in HttpOnly cookies, CSRF double-submit token, role-based access control (5 roles: SYSTEM_ADMIN, CONTRACTOR_ADMIN, PROJECT_CONTROLS, DISCIPLINE_PLANNER, SITE_SUPERVISOR). Auth endpoints: /auth/login, /auth/refresh, /auth/logout, /auth/me, /auth/users, /auth/csrf-token. CORS configured with strict allowlist. Organization/project scoping enforced via dependencies. Audit logging on auth events. Seed script creates demo org, project, and 5 users across all roles.

SQLite backup mechanism implemented as Celery Beat task (app/workers/backup.py). Dumps core tables to backups/consight_backup_<timestamp>.db with retention policy (keep last 24). Restore procedure documented in code.

Synthetic data generator (scripts/generate_synthetic_data.py) creates realistic multi-org, multi-project dataset: 2-3 orgs with 5 roles each, L1-L6 WBS tree (274 nodes) with predecessor/successor, weeks of field events across all 7 ingestion_sources (VOICE, TIME_AGENT, TEXT_DIARY, SPREADSHEET, PDF_OCR, PMIS_EXPORT, WHATSAPP) with realistic confidence distribution (auto-commit/review/new-activity), delay reasons across 8 categories, productivity benchmarks (10 activities), glossary mappings (10 code-mixed terms). Idempotent, parameterized (--project, --weeks, --seed).

Design system implemented per §6.2: CSS custom properties (--bg-app, --surface, --surface-raised, --border, --text, --text-muted, --accent, status colors), font families (Inter for UI, BubbledotICG-FinePos for display), spacing scale, border radius (pill 9999px), box shadows, transition durations/timing functions, animations (fade-in, slide-up, scale-in, pulse-soft), reduced motion support. Tailwind config with all tokens. Reusable components: Button, Badge, Card, Input/Textarea, Select, DataTable, Skeleton, EmptyState.

React+Vite+TS app with routing, auth context, 8 screens (Dashboard, Schedule, Planner Queue, Time Agent, Inbound, Insights, Risk, BIM, Admin, Settings), responsive sidebar, top bar, role-based access. Builds successfully.

Landing page implemented per §6.1: full-bleed video background, BubbledotICG-FinePos display font, Inter UI font, header/pill-nav/trust-row/hero/stats-footer composition, entrance animations (fade-in, slide-up), mobile burger menu, CTA wired to real /login flow, EPC/infrastructure trust brands (Bechtel, Fluor, AECOM, Jacobs, Kiewit, Vinci). Built with design system tokens from §6.2.

Complete P6/MSP round-trip per PRD §8.2 and add-on Phase 5: XER import/export with predecessor/successor (FS/SS/FF/SF + lag), .mpp support via mpxj, upsert by activity_code, write-back of actual_start/actual_finish on planner approval via /schedule/matches/{match_id}/resolve and review approve/correct endpoints, export includes actuals from schedule_activities. Added actual_start/actual_finish columns to schedule_activities with Alembic migration. Frontend: Schedule Import screen with upload, parse preview/diff (new/updated/unchanged badges), and commit; Export XER action from schedule view with schedule selector.

WhatsApp Business Cloud API webhook implemented per §5.2: /webhooks/whatsapp/inbound with Meta signature verification (X-Hub-Signature-256), GET verification endpoint, POST handler for inbound messages. Feeds same extraction→matching→confidence pipeline as /progress/extract. Persists messages as field_events with source_type='WHATSAPP' and ingestion_source_id linked to WHATSAPP source. Sends confirmation reply via Cloud API. Frontend: Inbound Channels panel with live feed from /progress/inbound/recent, source status grid (7 sources), auto-refresh every 10s, message status badges (matched/review/processing/new-activity) with activity code links. Config via env vars: WHATSAPP_APP_ID, WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET, WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN, WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN, WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

Multilingual extraction support for Hindi-English, Tamil-English, Telugu-English, and Kannada-English code-mixed input. Updated mock provider with language-specific keywords for event types (START/PROGRESS/COMPLETE/DELAY/HOLD), time formats (baje/mani/gante), location patterns (mein/la/lo/alli), date keywords (aaj/kal/naalai/repu/nale). Added 38 benchmark test cases in tests/fixtures/multilingual_benchmark.json with 85% accuracy threshold. Updated LLM provider prompts with multilingual extraction rules. Updated agent service with localized responses in 5 languages (en, hi, ta, te, kn). All multilingual tests pass.

P5-p6-roundtrip complete: XER/MSP import/export with predecessor/successor (FS/SS/FF/SF + lag), .mpp support via mpxj, upsert by activity_code, write-back of actuals on planner approval (/schedule/matches/{match_id}/resolve, review approve/correct), export includes actuals from schedule_activities. Alembic migration for actual_start/actual_finish. Frontend: Schedule Import with preview/diff/commit, Export action, schedule selector. Frontend builds, XER parser tests pass.

P6-whatsapp complete: WhatsApp Business Cloud API webhook per §5.2: /webhooks/whatsapp/inbound with Meta signature verification (X-Hub-Signature-256), GET verification, POST handler. Feeds same extraction→matching→confidence pipeline. Persists as field_events with source_type='WHATSAPP'. Sends confirmation reply via Cloud API. P7-multilingual complete: Multilingual extraction for Hindi-English, Tamil-English, Telugu-English, Kannada-English code-mixed input. 38 benchmark cases with 85% accuracy. Updated mock provider, LLM prompts, agent service with 5-language localized responses. All multilingual tests pass. Satisfies PRD §6.1 and add-on Phase 7.

P8-delay-ripple complete: Deterministic delay ripple computation per PRD §5.4 and add-on Phase 8. DelayRippleService computes propagated delays over predecessor/successor graph (FS/SS/FF/SF + lag) using CPM-based critical path detection and schedule margin analysis. Hooked into approve_review for DELAY events - auto-computes impacts when planner approves delay. Persists DelayImpact records with impact_type (DIRECT/PROPAGATED/FLOAT_CONSUMED/CRITICAL_PATH), propagated_delay_days, float_consumed_days, remaining_float_days, critical_path_exposure. API endpoints: /delay-impacts/event/{id}, /delay-impacts/activity/{id}, /delay-impacts/project/{id}/critical, /delay-impacts/project/{id}/summary. Frontend: DelayImpactPanel component integrated into ScheduleView and PlannerQueue with real-time display of impacted downstream activities, float consumption, and critical path warnings. 9 tests pass covering FS/SS/FF chains, float consumption, critical path detection, and multi-event accumulation.

P9-institutional-memory complete: Productivity & institutional memory analytics per PRD §6.6 and add-on Phase 9. AnalyticsService with SQL aggregations for: discipline summary (actual vs planned duration, productivity index, delay patterns), delay patterns (recurring causes by category/discipline, top causes), productivity benchmarks (historical rates by discipline/activity), variance trend (weekly buckets), matching quality (auto-commit/review/correction rates, avg confidence), confidence distribution. API endpoints: /analytics/discipline-summary, /analytics/delay-patterns, /analytics/benchmarks, /analytics/variance-trend, /analytics/matching-quality, /analytics/confidence-distribution. Frontend: Insights dashboard with real recharts visualizations - productivity bar chart, delay causes pie chart, variance trend line chart, detailed tables for top delays, benchmarks, and discipline summary. 7 tests pass covering all analytics endpoints.

P10-ml-delay-prediction complete: ML-based delay prediction per PRD §5.6/P10 and add-on Phase 10. DelayPredictionModel using RandomForest classifier/regressor trained on delay_reasons, productivity_benchmarks, schedule topology, and matching confidence. Features: 32 features including predecessor/successor topology, historical delay rates, discipline productivity, schedule float, critical path exposure, and confidence scores. Celery Beat tasks: daily retraining (retrain_delay_model), 6-hourly predictions for all projects (predict_all_projects). API endpoints: /delay-predictions/project/{id} (all predictions), /delay-predictions/project/{id}/watchlist (ranked risk watchlist), /delay-predictions/predict (generate predictions), /delay-predictions/train (trigger retraining), /delay-predictions/training-runs (model history). Frontend: RiskWatchlist with ranked risk table, risk score bars, ML confidence indicators, model performance metrics, and manual retrain button. 10 tests pass covering model training, feature extraction, prediction generation, and model persistence.
